summary: Applied Optoelectronics filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a standard AIA A141 design-build agreement with LCC3 Solution Inc. for a cleanroom construction project. The contract is valued at approximately $94.1 million with a targeted substantial completion date of January 10, 2027. This is an ordinary-course construction contract involving design, engineering, and procurement services, with progress payments, retainage, and liquidated damages provisions. It does not represent a change in control, capital structure, or special-situation corporate event. The filing is routine and not a special situation.
